description: The kitchen remodel, read by an implementation of FS_renovation that knows it: the wall between the Kitchen and the Utility room is to come down with its door, the Utility room and an old counter; a new wall and door make a Laundry of the Utility room's east half, a new window lights the Kitchen's new floor, an island is new, and so is a deck. It is valid - the combined document, and each state's view - reports nothing, and derives the IDs of each status, the quantities of each - walls, wall length, openings, rooms, slabs and slab area, extension elements - and the rooms of each state with their net areas: the Kitchen 12' x 12' as it stands and with the Utility room's west half when the work is done.
